title: fix(runtime): an api action whose target names its record is refused 400 naming recordId when called without one, never forwarded to a path with a hole in it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XL51wryBuAmngcxc4MhBYSV)_

Fixes #28932

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`type: 'api'` 动作的 `target` 里带记录占位（`{id}`、`${ctx.recordId}`、`{字段}`）时，调用方没传 `recordId`（或传了空串），动作入口现在直接回 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`，消息点名缺的是 `recordId`（记录上缺字段则点名那个字段），不再转发。REST 动作入口和 MCP `run_action` 共用同一处判断。
- **为什么改**：原来占位被清空或原样留在路径里转发出去，路由匹配不上，调用方收到 404 `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`「端点不存在」，会以为路由坏了，而不是自己漏了参数。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只把原来就失败的调用（404）改成 400 并说清原因；带真实 id 的调用（200）和未知 id 的调用（目标自己的 404 `REQUEST_NOT_FOUND`）照旧转发。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`（`buildApiActionRequest` 第 1 步路径拼装里新增的两处拒收和两个小函数）；`packages/runtime/src/domains/api-action-forward.test.ts`（文件末尾新增的一组用例）；`packages/verify/src/action-door-api-forward-denied-subject.test.ts`（真实启动栈上的两条新用例）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/api-action-forward.test.ts`，预期 73/73 通过（main 上新增用例 4 条红）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## Why

An integration calling a record-anchored `api` action over REST or MCP without its `recordId` was told the endpoint does not exist (404 `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`), so the cost of finding a missing parameter landed on the caller. The door now says which input is missing.

## What changes

**The seam.** `buildApiActionRequest` (`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`) assembles the forward for a same-origin `type: 'api'` action, and both action doors call it: REST `POST /api/v1/actions/:object/:action` (`domains/actions.ts`) and the MCP `run_action` bridge (`invokeBusinessAction`). Step 1 of it, the path, now refuses a record token it cannot fill, before anything is forwarded:

- **`${ctx.recordId}` left unresolved.** An empty `recordId` now counts as none (`input.recordId || record.id || undefined`), so `${ctx.recordId}` stays in place instead of being blanked to `''`. It is refused naming `recordId`, ahead of the browser-only token refusal that would otherwise claim it with a sentence saying the server *does* interpolate `${ctx.recordId}`.
- **`{field}` left unresolved.** A field the row has no value for (`null`, `undefined` or `''`) is left in place, never blanked. After the browser-only refusal (so a `{{page.x}}` keeps that refusal), any `{field}` token still in the path is refused: naming `recordId` when the caller named no record, otherwise naming the field. Without a row, `{id}` is filled from the routed `recordId`, the same source `recordIdParam` already uses. Both doors always pass a row, so that branch is reachable only by a direct caller of the function.
- **The refusal shape is the existing one.** The function returns `{ status: 400, message }`, as its other refusals do. The REST door answers it through `deps.error(message, 400)` and the MCP door throws it with `standardErrorCodeForHttpStatus(400)`, so both answer `VALIDATION_ERROR`. No new error code. No runtime string carries a tracker number.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/api-action-missing-record-id.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/runtime`, with both declaration lines.

**Step 1 measurement (the order's ruling 2).** Every `api` action in this repo whose `target` carries a `{field}` token names `{id}` alone: the nine `sys_approval_request` decision actions in `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.ts` (`approve`, `reject`, `reassign`, `revise`, `request-info`, `remind`, `recall`, `resubmit`, `comment`) and the two `sys_api_key` actions in `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-api-key.object.ts`. `ui/apps/console/src/dev/DevRecordHeaderActions.tsx` has one more `{id}` target (a dev-only page). Two actions use `${ctx.recordId}` instead: `packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-admin-plugin.ts` (`/test`, `/migrate-credential`). `examples/` has no record-token api target; its only `{{categoryId}}` hit is a QA step in `examples/app-showcase/qa/platform-smoke.test.json`, not an action. hotcrm (`d4ffe99`) has none.

## Tests

- **Unit, new block at the end of `packages/runtime/src/domains/api-action-forward.test.ts`** (5 tests):
  - REST: the approve shape (`/api/v1/approvals/requests/{id}/approve`) with `{ params: {} }` and with `{ recordId: '', params: {} }`: 400, code `VALIDATION_ERROR` (pinned against `standardErrorCodeForHttpStatus(400)` and literally), the message names `` `recordId` ``, and the in-process request is never called.
  - REST: a `${ctx.recordId}` target (a `DELETE`) and a `{email}` target, each with no id and with `''`: the same refusal, nothing forwarded.
  - REST controls: a real id is forwarded (200, the id in the URL); an unknown id is forwarded and the target's 404 `REQUEST_NOT_FOUND` is relayed; a target with no token is forwarded with no id (200).
  - MCP `run_action`: the approve shape with no id and with `''` is thrown 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` naming `recordId`, nothing forwarded.
  - `buildApiActionRequest`: a row without `email`, with `email: null` and with `email: ''` is refused naming `` `email` ``; no row at all names `recordId`; `{id}` without a row is filled from the routed id, percent-encoded.
- **Real stack, two new cases in `packages/verify/src/action-door-api-forward-denied-subject.test.ts`** (booted stack, real approvals routes, a non-admin pending approver):
  - `POST /api/v1/actions/sys_approval_request/approval_approve` with `{ params: {} }` and with `{ recordId: '' }`: 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` naming `recordId`, and the request is untouched (no approve row, slate unchanged).
  - Control: an id that names no request answers the decision route's 404 `REQUEST_NOT_FOUND`. The existing case in the same file already pins the real-id 200.
- **Red on base `f7c545ad`.** Unit file with `action-execution.ts` checked out from base: 4 failed, 69 passed (the four refusal tests; all controls green). Verify file with runtime `dist` rebuilt from base: 1 failed, 4 passed, the failure reading `{"code":"ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND","message":"Not found","httpStatus":404}`, which is the card's repro. Both trees restored: `git status --porcelain` empty, blob equal to HEAD, runtime rebuilt.
- **Green on head.** Unit file 73/73. Verify file 5/5.

<details><summary>Ablation (one-off, from committed HEAD)</summary>

Both guard lines replaced through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0 each): the `${ctx.recordId}` check by one that tests for the marker `ABLATED-28932-A`, and the `{field}` check by one that tests for `ABLATED-28932-B`, so the helper stays referenced and the build still type-checks.

- Unit file (reads `action-execution.ts` from source): 4 failed, 69 passed, the same four tests as on base.
- Verify file (reads runtime `dist`): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime build`, then `node scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/runtime 'ABLATED-28932-B'` answered "marker present in 2 built files". 1 failed, 4 passed. With the guard ablated, the `{id}` token is no longer blanked, so the forward reaches the route with `{id}` literally and the route answers 400 `FILTER_TOKEN_UNKNOWN`; the pin still reds because the code is not `VALIDATION_ERROR`.
- Restore: `git checkout HEAD -- PATH`, `git diff HEAD` 0 bytes, blob `12811782c09a` equal to HEAD; rebuilt, and `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs --absent` answered "marker absent from all 12 built files" and "working tree clean against HEAD".

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Accept set.** Every call refused now was already a failure on `main`: a forward to a path with a hole in it, answered 404 by the router (or, for an `{id}` the approvals route read literally, 400 `FILTER_TOKEN_UNKNOWN`). Hence `Clause-②: no`. One odd shape moves from forwarded to refused: a target written with a scope-less `${name}` or `{{name}}` whose `{name}` part matched no row field used to be blanked to `$` or `{}` and forwarded; it now stays in place and gets the existing browser-only refusal. No such target exists in this repo, `examples/` or hotcrm (measurement above).
- **The console path is not touched.** `ui/` resolves its own click-time tokens; this PR changes only the server's forward.
- **Ordering of refusals.** The record-token refusal runs before the same-origin check and the body checks, so a call that is missing its id is told that first.
